DurableScope is <None />: no graph module is written. ObservedWriteScope is the record files, the validator scripts and tests, and package.json. Do not add spec.xml or plan.xml. Do not mint M-LINT-CATALOG, M-REVIEW, M-SKILLS, M-TEST-SUPPORT, or M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION. No design-context.xml. Ceilings are formulas computed at execution after the initial eligible moves, never a scalar of decisions.md. Qualifier-id three-way: licensed-alone must flip 1→0; unique-primary must stay 0; unlicensed must stay 1. Current-mode lint of this root is not a task Verification command and is not a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand. Selected --assertions baseline before writes; --assertions target --run-commands after the split. MustPassCommand holds leaf tests and validator scripts. Do not require bun run validate:ci. TargetAssertions MustExist names only paths that already exist; new paths are Baseline MustNotExist plus Target MustPassCommand, because review.confidently-wrong treats every MustExist as a present-tense disk claim (src/review/core.ts:501-536), including under TargetAssertions.

A planted unresolved ](findings.md#f9999) exits non-zero. Qualifier-id three-way, all planted in scripts/validate-citation-anchors.test.ts, not only the case that flips. Errors per live registry.xml row whose name equals such a directory. Exceeding a ceiling fails; the message names move to the retired sibling and does not name a config key. Zero historical codifiedIn or taughtIn tags. Both resolution checks ship for each tag: unresolvable pointer is an error; removing or renaming the named check or pinned skill text while a live tag stands is an error.
